dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents in Swat, Lower Dir  and Malakand Districts, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan  as of 1 July 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20250630PAK** This map illustrates the satellite detected water extent in Swat, Lower Dir and Malakand Districts, Pakistan as observed from a Sentinel-2 satellite image acquired on 1 July 2025 at 10:56 local time (05:56 UTC). Within the analyzed area of approximately 900 km², about 40 km² of land appears to be affected by floodwaters. Based on WorldPop population data and the flood extent, approximately 105,000 people are potentially exposed or living close to the flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
